props.heading: Three things we are known for

items.title: Dhaka from Palpa and Tehrathum
items.text: Dhaka saris, shawls and topi cloth from family looms we have bought from for twenty years. Each sari takes a weaver about ten days; the pattern is counted by hand, thread by thread.

image.alt: Hands guiding cloth under a sewing machine needle

items.title: A tailoring floor upstairs
items.text: Four tailors on the second floor. Fall and pico while you drink tea, a blouse in three days, kurta suruwal in a week. Bring a blouse that fits and we will copy it.

image.alt: A man in a pale yellow kurta against a warm wall

items.title: For the men of the family
items.text: Daura suruwal made to measure, cotton and silk kurtas, and Dhaka topi in every size. Grooms and their brothers can be measured together.

props.quote: My grandfather sold cloth from a wooden box on this corner. We still unfold every sari on the floor for you, the way he did.

items.q: Can I see saris on Viber first?
items.a: Yes. Send what you are looking for and a budget, and we send photos and prices the same day.
Inside the valley, free on orders over Rs 10,000. Outside the valley by courier, paid by you, usually two to four days.
Within seven days, unworn, unwashed and with the tag, for an exchange or a credit note. Stitched blouses cannot be returned.
Cash, card, eSewa, Khalti or Fonepay QR. For wedding orders, a 30% advance.

items.q: How do I store a Banarasi?
items.a: Folded in a muslin cloth, not plastic, and refolded every few months so the zari does not crack at the folds.
A little at the first wash. We can pre-wash it for you for Rs 300 before stitching the blouse.

pages.seoDescription: Bridal saris, family orders and the groom’s daura suruwal, chosen in one private afternoon at Indra Chowk, Kathmandu.

props.title: Wedding orders for the whole family
props.text: The bride’s sari, the mothers’ and the sisters’, the groom’s daura suruwal and the topi, chosen together in one afternoon and stitched in time.

image.alt: A woman in a red and gold Banarasi sari

props.eyebrow: Book three to six weeks before the wedding

props.heading: How a wedding afternoon works
props.body:
We close the first floor for you for two hours. Bring the bride, the mothers, the sisters and anyone whose opinion matters. We bring the tea.

We start with the bride’s wedding sari, then the reception, then the family. Blouses are measured the same afternoon, and the groom’s side can come another day for the daura suruwal.
